_meta.description: Infrastructure obligations reconstructed from the S-1/A (Nov 2, 2026), MD&A — Contractual Obligations (pp. 173–176) and Notes 7, 13, 16, 17. $ millions.
_meta.doubleCountingRule: The five 'buckets' sum to the $895.4B aggregate and do not overlap. Named counterparty arrangements are a different cut of the same money: their fixed/minimum amounts sit inside the buckets (the filing does not map agreement-to-bucket), so they must never be added to the bucket total. Arrangements without fixed dollar amounts are explicitly excluded from the aggregate.

buckets.label: Contractual obligations table (non-cancelable, term > 1 year)
buckets.detail: Operating leases $4,224M; finance leases $1,950M; purchase commitments (mainly CSP hosting) $313,819M

buckets.label: Short-term commitments (cancelable within a year or term ≤ 1 year)
Leases executed, not yet commenced
buckets.detail: Commence 2026–2028; terms < 1 to 20 years; weighted-average ≈ 10 years. Includes most of the ~$161.2B Broadcom TPU equipment leases and data-center leases (inference: the commenced finance-lease balance is only $1.95B).

buckets.label: Commitments entered into after Sep 30, 2026
buckets.detail: Primarily data-center leases and CSP hosting / third-party infrastructure; some subject to contingent conditions

buckets.label: Short-term agreements entered into after Sep 30, 2026

history.label: New / amended lease & commercial agreements (minimum payments)

counterparties.name: Broadcom (and assigned financing SPVs)
counterparties.amountBasis: Aggregate rent excl. interest (2026 Lease Arrangement alone ≈ $125.2B)
counterparties.period: Five-year terms; capacity online from 2026, more from 2027
counterparties.cancelability: Non-cancelable by either party except lessor on default; cross-default and acceleration provisions
counterparties.financing: Up to $42.0B Infrastructure Partner 2026 NPA may fund quarterly rent (9% PIK; 13% if revenue conditions missed); restricted-cash deposits for Broadcom's benefit
counterparties.inAggregate: Yes — mostly within 'leases not yet commenced' (inference)
counterparties.dependency: Broadcom/Google TPU supply; data-center operators; lessor financing partners

counterparties.name: Google (Cloud)
counterparties.amountBasis: Minimum spend 'regardless of actual usage' (was $114.5B in the Oct 26 S-1)
counterparties.cancelability: Non-cancelable except Google's uncured material breach
counterparties.financing: Google 2026 NPA: up to $20.0B ($10.0B less if Google buys IPO-concurrent shares)
counterparties.dependency: Google is investor (cap 14.99%), supplier, distributor (Vertex AI) and competitor (Gemini)

counterparties.name: Google / third-party TPU providers — additional TPU compute
counterparties.amountBasis: Company estimate of aggregate future payments
counterparties.cancelability: Delivery-method dependent (CSP hosting, direct purchase with 5-year financing, or third-party lease)

counterparties.name: Amazon (AWS)
counterparties.chip: Not specified in this agreement description (multi-chip incl. Trainium per filing)
counterparties.cancelability: Non-cancelable except Amazon's uncured material breach
counterparties.financing: Amazon 2026 NPA: up to $15.0B in $5.0B tranches on compute-capacity milestones; $6.2B Amazon notes outstanding (share-settled)
counterparties.dependency: Amazon is investor (cap 12%), supplier, distributor (Bedrock) and competitor

counterparties.name: SpaceXAI (formerly X.AI LLC; SpaceX subsidiary)
counterparties.amountBasis: 'Up to' — ≈ $3.1B per month once all capacity delivered (expected Dec 2026)
counterparties.cancelability: After non-cancelable periods ending Jan and Mar 2027, either party may cancel on 90 days' notice
counterparties.inAggregate: Minimum portion only (filing does not quantify)
counterparties.dependency: A direct frontier-model competitor (Grok) is a top-three compute supplier by headline value

counterparties.name: Microsoft (Azure)
counterparties.cancelability: Non-cancelable except Microsoft's uncured breach or, per tranche, undelivered tranches
counterparties.dependency: Microsoft is investor, distributor (Foundry / Copilot) and competitor (MAI, OpenAI partner)

counterparties.name: Nscale
counterparties.amountBasis: 'Up to'; fees accrue only as capacity is delivered and accepted
counterparties.cancelability: Non-cancelable except delivery/availability failures or breach
counterparties.financing: Nscale must use best efforts to obtain qualifying financing
counterparties.dependency: Neocloud balance sheet and financing markets

counterparties.name: Lambda
counterparties.amountBasis: Aggregate; fees accrue as capacity is delivered and accepted
counterparties.cancelability: Aug 2026 agreement (~$34.9B) terminable if Lambda does not timely secure the facility lease
counterparties.inAggregate: Yes; ~$34.9B tied to a facility-lease condition

counterparties.name: AMD
counterparties.amountBasis: Expected to exceed $20.0B if full initial capacity procured; up to ~2× with optional capacity
counterparties.period: Initial tranche in 2027; no fixed term
counterparties.cancelability: Non-cancelable except AMD breach; conditions on deployment proposals may be waived by Anthropic
counterparties.financing: AMD commitment to buy up to $5.0B Class N stock on delivery milestones (first expected 2027)
counterparties.inAggregate: No — explicitly excluded (no fixed dollar commitment)

financing.label: A&R Credit Facility availability ($15.0B facility; $205M letters of credit)
financing.note: Matures Sep 2031; $5.0B minimum-liquidity covenant from Q4 2026

financing.label: Google 2026 NPA (conditional)
financing.note: Draw period through Dec 2030; linked to third-party compute and TTM revenue conditions; reduced by up to $10B if Google buys IPO-concurrent shares

financing.label: Amazon 2026 NPA (conditional)
financing.note: $5.0B increments on compute-capacity milestones; settles in Class N shares post-IPO

financing.label: Infrastructure Partner 2026 NPA — Broadcom (conditional, rent-only)
financing.note: Only to fund rent on the 2026 Lease Arrangement; 9% PIK (13% if revenue conditions missed); convertible at 90% (85%) of 30-day VWAP

financing.label: AMD equity commitment (conditional)
financing.note: Drawable after GPU delivery milestones; first expected 2027
